## About
Ace Rooter Plumbing and Drain Services is a local plumbing and drain cleaning company on E Street in Chula Vista. We work on homes and businesses here and throughout San Diego County, from slow sinks and clogged tubs to sewer backups, sewer camera inspections and hydro jetting.
Reviewers mention Manny by name, and some describe Manny and his son working on their drains together. Customers say we take the time to find the real problem and fix it completely. We currently hold a 5 star rating from 66 Google reviews.

## Services
- Basic drain cleaning: Unclogging standard drains, including kitchen and lav sinks, showers, tubs and toilets.
- Sewer main line unclog and camera inspection: We clear the main line through proper cleanout access and inspect it with a camera.
- Complete sewer and drain service with hydro jetter: A full sewer and drain jetting service for residential and commercial properties.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work in Chula Vista and throughout San Diego County.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7 AM to 10 PM. Sunday hours end a little earlier in the evening.

Q: What if the problem comes back after the visit?
A: One reviewer said that when a clogged bathtub drain needed more attention, the crew came back a second time at no extra charge and fixed it properly.
